name: Call Analyzer
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y ffmpeg && pip install --user -r requirements.txt
postAttachCommand: streamlit run app.py --server.headless true --server.enableCORS false --server.enableXsrfProtection false

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for call reviews (console.anthropic.com)

SARVAM_API_KEY.description: Sarvam AI key for Hindi/Hinglish speech-to-text (dashboard.sarvam.ai)

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional: OpenAI key if you use the OpenAI speech engine
